detect_up_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall provide a comprehensive s
detect_up_01.description: The cloud provider shall provide a comprehensive system description that outlines the architecture, components, and operational characteristics of the cloud service to ensure transparency for customers.

detect_up_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall disclose all jurisdiction
detect_up_02.description: The cloud provider shall disclose all jurisdictions and physical locations where customer data is stored, processed, and backed up to ensure compliance with data residency requirements.

detect_up_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall disclose applicable legal
detect_up_03.description: The cloud provider shall disclose applicable legal frameworks, disclosure requirements, and investigatory powers that may affect customer data, including government access requests and mandatory disclosure laws.

detect_up_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall maintain and disclose all
detect_up_04.description: The cloud provider shall maintain and disclose all relevant certifications, attestations, and independent audit reports that demonstrate compliance with security standards and industry best practices.

detect_ois_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement and maintain a
detect_ois_01.description: The cloud provider shall implement and maintain a documented Information Security Management System (ISMS) that defines security policies, procedures, and controls to protect information assets in accordance with established security objectives.

detect_ois_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define strategic informat
detect_ois_02.description: The cloud provider shall define strategic information security targets and ensure top management takes responsibility for information security, including the allocation of resources and commitment to security objectives.

detect_ois_03.name: Detect: The organization defines and documents clear autho
detect_ois_03.description: The organization defines and documents clear authorities and responsibilities for information security within the organization to ensure accountability and effective governance of security measures.

detect_ois_04.name: Detect: The organization ensures appropriate separation of
detect_ois_04.description: The organization ensures appropriate separation of duties is implemented to prevent single individuals from having excessive control over critical processes that could lead to fraud or error.

detect_ois_05.name: Detect: The organization maintains appropriate contact wit
detect_ois_05.description: The organization maintains appropriate contact with relevant government agencies, regulatory bodies, and industry interest groups to stay informed about security threats, legal requirements, and best practices.

detect_ois_06.name: Detect: The organization establishes and documents a polic
detect_ois_06.description: The organization establishes and documents a policy for the organization of risk management that defines the approach, methods, and responsibilities for identifying, analyzing, and handling information security risks.

detect_ois_07.name: Detect: The organization systematically identifies, analyz
detect_ois_07.description: The organization systematically identifies, analyzes, assesses, and handles information security risks to ensure appropriate mitigation measures are implemented in accordance with the risk management policy.

detect_sa_01.name: Detect: The organization documents, communicates, and make
detect_sa_01.description: The organization documents, communicates, and makes available all information security policies and work instructions to relevant personnel in a timely and accessible manner.

detect_sa_02.name: Detect: The organization ensures that all information secu
detect_sa_02.description: The organization ensures that all information security policies and work instructions are reviewed and approved by appropriate management before issuance and are subject to periodic review.

detect_sa_03.name: Detect: The organization defines and documents procedures
detect_sa_03.description: The organization defines and documents procedures for handling deviations from established policies and instructions, including approval requirements and documentation of exceptions.

detect_hr_01.name: Detect: The organization conducts appropriate security che
detect_hr_01.description: The organization conducts appropriate security checks on prospective employees, including verification of identity, employment history, education, and criminal background checks where permitted by law.

detect_hr_02.name: Detect: The organization ensures that employment agreement
detect_hr_02.description: The organization ensures that employment agreements include appropriate clauses regarding information security obligations, confidentiality requirements, and acceptable use policies.

detect_hr_03.name: Detect: The organization implements a comprehensive securi
detect_hr_03.description: The organization implements a comprehensive security training and awareness programme to ensure all employees understand their information security responsibilities and are aware of current threats and best practices.

detect_hr_04.name: Detect: The organization defines and communicates discipli
detect_hr_04.description: The organization defines and communicates disciplinary measures for violations of information security policies and procedures to ensure consistent enforcement and deterrence of security breaches.

detect_hr_05.name: Detect: The organization implements procedures for the sec
detect_hr_05.description: The organization implements procedures for the secure termination of employment or changes in responsibilities, including revocation of access rights, return of assets, and completion of exit interviews.

detect_am_01.name: Detect: The organization maintains a complete and up-to-da
detect_am_01.description: The organization maintains a complete and up-to-date inventory of all information system assets, including hardware, software, and data assets, with appropriate classification and ownership.

detect_am_02.name: Detect: The organization assigns clear ownership and respo
detect_am_02.description: The organization assigns clear ownership and responsibility for each asset to ensure accountability for the protection and proper management of all information system assets.

detect_am_03.name: Detect: The organization ensures that appropriate instruct
detect_am_03.description: The organization ensures that appropriate instruction manuals, user guides, and technical documentation are available for all assets to ensure proper and secure operation.

detect_am_04.name: Detect: The organization implements procedures for the pro
detect_am_04.description: The organization implements procedures for the proper handover and return of assets, including verification of asset condition and ensuring all access rights are revoked upon return.

detect_am_05.name: Detect: The organization implements an information classif
detect_am_05.description: The organization implements an information classification scheme to ensure that information is appropriately protected based on its sensitivity, criticality, and business value.

detect_am_06.name: Detect: The organization implements appropriate labelling
detect_am_06.description: The organization implements appropriate labelling of information and assets based on their classification to ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal according to sensitivity levels.

detect_am_07.name: Detect: The organization implements controls for the secur
detect_am_07.description: The organization implements controls for the secure management of data media, including storage, transportation, reuse, and disposal to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information.

detect_am_08.name: Detect: The organization implements procedures for the sec
detect_am_08.description: The organization implements procedures for the secure transfer and removal of assets, including hardware, software, and data, to prevent unauthorized disclosure or loss of information.

detect_ps_01.name: Detect: The organization implements physical perimeter sec
detect_ps_01.description: The organization implements physical perimeter security measures, including fences, walls, barriers, or other physical controls to prevent unauthorized access to the facility.

detect_ps_02.name: Detect: The organization implements physical access contro
detect_ps_02.description: The organization implements physical access controls at site entry points, including access cards, biometric systems, or other authentication mechanisms to control and monitor physical access.

detect_ps_03.name: Detect: The organization implements measures to protect ag
detect_ps_03.description: The organization implements measures to protect against environmental threats including natural disasters, extreme weather, fire, flood, and other external threats to infrastructure.

detect_rb_10.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define and implement a co
detect_rb_10.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement a comprehensive logging and monitoring concept that covers all relevant systems, applications, and security-relevant events.

detect_rb_13.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement secure storage
detect_rb_13.description: The cloud provider shall implement secure storage for logs that prevents unauthorized modification, deletion, or access, and ensures log retention in accordance with legal and contractual requirements.

detect_rb_17.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define and implement a co
detect_rb_17.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement a concept for handling vulnerabilities, malfunctions, and errors that includes processes for identification, assessment, remediation, and communication.

detect_rb_22.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement system hardenin
detect_rb_22.description: The cloud provider shall implement system hardening measures, including secure configuration, removal of unnecessary services and software, and application of security patches.

detect_idm_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define and document a pol
detect_idm_01.description: The cloud provider shall define and document a policy for system and data access authorizations that establishes principles for granting, reviewing, and revoking access rights.

detect_idm_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement timely de-provi
detect_idm_04.description: The cloud provider shall implement timely de-provisioning of access authorizations when changes occur to employment relationships, including termination, role changes, or transfers.

detect_idm_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall conduct regular reviews o
detect_idm_05.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular reviews of data access authorizations to ensure that access rights remain appropriate and are revoked when no longer required.

detect_idm_11.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define and enforce passwo
detect_idm_11.description: The cloud provider shall define and enforce password requirements, including minimum length, complexity, expiration, and prevention of password reuse.

detect_kry_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a com
detect_kry_01.description: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a comprehensive policy governing the use of cryptographic procedures and key management. This policy defines encryption standards, key generation, storage, distribution, rotation, and destruction procedures.

detect_kry_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements transport layer secu
detect_kry_02.description: The cloud provider implements transport layer security mechanisms to encrypt all data transmitted between users, systems, and cloud services. This includes encryption of data in transit over internal and external networks using industry-standard protocols.

detect_kry_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider encrypts sensitive data at rest
detect_kry_03.description: The cloud provider encrypts sensitive data at rest using appropriate cryptographic mechanisms. This includes encryption of customer data, databases, file systems, and backup storage using strong encryption algorithms.

detect_kry_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements secure key managemen
detect_kry_04.description: The cloud provider implements secure key management practices including secure generation, storage, distribution, rotation, and destruction of cryptographic keys. Keys are protected against unauthorized access, modification, and disclosure.

detect_kos_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements technical safeguards
detect_kos_01.description: The cloud provider implements technical safeguards to protect network communications and system interfaces. This includes firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and other technical controls to secure network perimeters and communication channels.

detect_kos_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements controls to segregat
detect_kos_05.description: The cloud provider implements controls to segregate data traffic in shared or multi-tenant network environments. Customer data traffic is logically or physically separated to prevent unauthorized access or interference between tenants.

detect_bei_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes policies governing
detect_bei_03.description: The cloud provider establishes policies governing changes to information systems, including procedures for requesting, approving, implementing, and documenting changes.

detect_bei_07.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements comprehensive testin
detect_bei_07.description: The cloud provider implements comprehensive testing procedures for all changes to information systems. Testing includes functional, security, and performance testing before changes are deployed to production environments.

detect_bei_09.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements a review process to
detect_bei_09.description: The cloud provider implements a review process to verify that changes have been properly tested and have received appropriate approval before implementation. This includes verification of test coverage and approval workflows.

detect_dll_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements policies for handlin
detect_dll_01.description: The cloud provider implements policies for handling service providers and suppliers that define security requirements, contractual obligations, and oversight procedures.

detect_dll_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider monitors the rendering of servi
detect_dll_02.description: The cloud provider monitors the rendering of services and security requirements for service providers and suppliers to ensure ongoing compliance with contractual and regulatory obligations.

detect_sim_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider defines clear responsibilities
detect_sim_01.description: The cloud provider defines clear responsibilities and establishes a procedural model for managing security incidents, including roles, escalation paths, and communication procedures.

detect_sim_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements a classification sys
detect_sim_02.description: The cloud provider implements a classification system for customer systems to determine appropriate security incident handling procedures based on criticality and sensitivity.

detect_sim_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes procedures for proc
detect_sim_03.description: The cloud provider establishes procedures for processing security incidents, including detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery steps.

detect_sim_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider maintains comprehensive documen
detect_sim_04.description: The cloud provider maintains comprehensive documentation of all security incidents and provides timely reporting to relevant stakeholders and customers as required.

detect_sim_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements security incident ev
detect_sim_05.description: The cloud provider implements security incident event management capabilities to collect, correlate, and analyze security events from various sources.

detect_sim_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes obligations for use
detect_sim_06.description: The cloud provider establishes obligations for users to report security incidents to a central body within the organization.

detect_sim_07.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements processes to evaluat
detect_sim_07.description: The cloud provider implements processes to evaluate security incidents, identify root causes, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.

detect_bcm_01.name: Detect: Top management of the cloud provider takes respons
detect_bcm_01.description: Top management of the cloud provider takes responsibility for business continuity management, including defining strategy, allocating resources, and ensuring organizational commitment.

detect_bcm_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes policies and proced
detect_bcm_02.description: The cloud provider establishes policies and procedures for conducting business impact analysis to identify critical business functions and their recovery requirements.

detect_bcm_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider develops and maintains business
detect_bcm_03.description: The cloud provider develops and maintains business continuity plans to ensure the continued delivery of critical services during and after a disruption.

detect_bcm_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider regularly verifies, updates, an
detect_bcm_04.description: The cloud provider regularly verifies, updates, and tests business continuity plans to ensure their effectiveness and relevance.

detect_bcm_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider ensures the reliable supply of
detect_bcm_05.description: The cloud provider ensures the reliable supply of computing centres, including power, cooling, and connectivity, to support business continuity requirements.

detect_spn_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider ensures that top management is
detect_spn_01.description: The cloud provider ensures that top management is notified of significant security issues and audit findings in a timely manner.

detect_spn_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to ver
detect_spn_02.description: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to verify compliance of IT processes with internal security policies and standards.

detect_spn_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to ver
detect_spn_03.description: The cloud provider conducts internal audits to verify compliance of IT systems with internal security policies and standards.

detect_com_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider identifies and documents all ap
detect_com_01.description: The cloud provider identifies and documents all applicable legal, contractual, and data protection requirements relevant to its operations and customer data.

detect_com_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider plans independent external audi
detect_com_02.description: The cloud provider plans independent external audits to verify compliance with applicable requirements and standards.

detect_com_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider conducts independent external a
detect_com_03.description: The cloud provider conducts independent external audits in accordance with the planned schedule and reports findings to relevant stakeholders.

detect_mdm_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes policies and proced
detect_mdm_01.description: The cloud provider establishes policies and procedures to minimize risks associated with access via mobile terminal devices owned or managed by the cloud provider.

detect_c5_org_01.name: Detect: Planning, implementation, maintenance and continuo
detect_c5_org_01.description: Planning, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of a framework regarding information security within the organisation.

detect_c5_pol_01.name: Detect: Providing policies and instructions with respect t
detect_c5_pol_01.description: Providing policies and instructions with respect to the security claim and to support the business requirements.

detect_c5_per_01.name: Detect: Making sure that employees, service providers and
detect_c5_per_01.description: Making sure that employees, service providers and suppliers understand their tasks, are aware of their responsibility with regard to information security and that the assets of the organisation are protected if the tasks are modified or completed.

detect_c5_ast_01.name: Detect: The organization shall identify the organisation's
detect_c5_ast_01.description: The organization shall identify the organisation's own assets and responsible persons as well as ensuring an appropriate level of protection. Asset inventory shall be maintained and classification schemes implemented.

detect_c5_phy_01.name: Detect: Preventing unauthorised physical access and protec
detect_c5_phy_01.description: Preventing unauthorised physical access and protection against theft, damage, loss and failure of operations.

detect_c5_ops_01.name: Detect: Assuring proper regular operations including appro
detect_c5_ops_01.description: Assuring proper regular operations including appropriate safeguards for planning and monitoring the capacity, protection against malware, logging and monitoring events as well as handling vulnerabilities, malfunctions and errors.

detect_c5_iam_01.name: Detect: Securing the authorisation and authentication of u
detect_c5_iam_01.description: Securing the authorisation and authentication of users of the cloud provider (usually privileged user) and the cloud customer in order to prevent unauthorised access.

detect_c5_cry_01.name: Detect: Ensuring proper use of cryptographic methods and s
detect_c5_cry_01.description: Ensuring proper use of cryptographic methods and secure key management to protect data confidentiality and integrity.

detect_c5_com_01.name: Detect: The organization shall protect information in netw
detect_c5_com_01.description: The organization shall protect information in networks and the corresponding information processing facilities. Network security controls shall be implemented to protect information transferred across network boundaries.

detect_c5_ccs_01.name: Detect: The provider defines and documents the cloud compu
detect_c5_ccs_01.description: The provider defines and documents the cloud computing concept, including the architecture of the cloud service, the used components, the separation mechanisms, the interfaces to other services and the underlying infrastructure.

detect_c5_conf_01.name: Detect: The provider implements a configuration management
detect_c5_conf_01.description: The provider implements a configuration management process to ensure that the configuration of information-processing systems is documented, controlled, and maintained in a secure manner.

detect_c5_port_01.name: Detect: Providing the ability to securely operate the serv
detect_c5_port_01.description: Providing the ability to securely operate the service on different IT platforms as well as the possibility of secure connections to different IT platforms and termination of the service.

detect_c5_proc_01.name: Detect: Complying with the security targets in case of new
detect_c5_proc_01.description: Complying with the security targets in case of new developments and procurement of information systems as well as changes.

detect_c5_sup_01.name: Detect: Protecting information that can be accessed by ser
detect_c5_sup_01.description: Protecting information that can be accessed by service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider (subcontractors) and monitoring the services and security requirements agreed upon.

detect_c5_sim_01.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_sim_01.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 in order to ensure a fast, effective and proper response to all known security incidents.

detect_c5_bcm_01.name: Detect: Strategic establishment and governance of a busine
detect_c5_bcm_01.description: Strategic establishment and governance of a business continuity management (BCM). Planning, implementing and testing business continuity concepts as well as incorporating safeguards in order to ensure and maintain continuous operations.

detect_c5_ver_01.name: Detect: Checking and verifying that the information securi
detect_c5_ver_01.description: Checking and verifying that the information security safeguards are implemented and carried out in accordance with the organisation-wide policies and instructions.

detect_c5_comp_01.name: Detect: Preventing violations against statutory or contrac
detect_c5_comp_01.description: Preventing violations against statutory or contractual duties with respect to information security.

detect_c5_mdm_01.name: Detect: Guaranteeing secure access to IT systems via mobil
detect_c5_mdm_01.description: Guaranteeing secure access to IT systems via mobile devices in the cloud provider's responsibility to develop and operate the cloud service.

detect_c5_op_01.name: Detect: Type 2 audit and reporting is required to provide
detect_c5_op_01.description: Type 2 audit and reporting is required to provide an appropriate informative opinion. Type 1 reporting should only be carried out in exceptional cases (e.g., foundation of the cloud provider, acquisition of new cloud services) and must be justified within the report. Type 1 reporting is suitable for initial audits of newly developed cloud services to obtain an audit result in a timely manner but is not suitable for demonstrating effective implementation over a retrospective period of time.

detect_c5_op_02.name: Detect: For Type 2 audits, the audit period usually covers
detect_c5_op_02.description: For Type 2 audits, the audit period usually covers twelve months, but not less than six months. Shorter audit periods can be taken into account in exceptional cases (e.g., foundation of the cloud provider, acquisition of new cloud services) and must be justified within the report.

detect_c5_op_03.name: Detect: The basic requirements (and, where applicable, the
detect_c5_op_03.description: The basic requirements (and, where applicable, the additional requirements) must be addressed completely and without omissions. The audit and reporting can be based either on the basic requirements alone or on the basic requirements together with the additional requirements.

detect_c5_op_04.name: Detect: The subject of the audit includes the description
detect_c5_op_04.description: The subject of the audit includes the description of the internal control system related to the cloud services (system description). The responsibility for the system description and its content lies with the legal representatives of the provider. The system description must properly reflect the actual design and implementation of the internal control system related to the cloud services at the time of the audit.

detect_c5_op_05.name: Detect: The management statement includes the appropriaten
detect_c5_op_05.description: The management statement includes the appropriateness and usually also the effectiveness of the internal control system presented in the system description. The processes and procedures for implementing and executing the presented controls are also included in the management statement.

detect_c5_op_06.name: Detect: For Type 1 audits, the auditor has to assess wheth
detect_c5_op_06.description: For Type 1 audits, the auditor has to assess whether the controls presented have been designed appropriately. The auditor must assess whether the system description properly reflects the actual design and implementation of the internal control system related to the cloud services at the time of the audit.

detect_c5_op_07.name: Detect: As compared to Type 1 audit and reporting, the aud
detect_c5_op_07.description: As compared to Type 1 audit and reporting, the auditor performs additional audit activities with respect to the effectiveness of the controls (functional tests) for Type 2 audits.

detect_c5_org_02.name: Detect: External service providers and suppliers of the cl
detect_c5_org_02.description: External service providers and suppliers of the cloud provider, who contribute to the development or operation of the cloud service, are obliged by contract to make their employees and subcontractors aware of the specific security requirements of the cloud provider and train their employees generally in the subject of information security. The cloud provider checks on a random basis that the service providers and suppliers have carried out the instruction in an appropriate manner.

detect_c5_org_03.name: Detect: Operative and controlling functions should not be
detect_c5_org_03.description: Operative and controlling functions should not be performed by one and the same person at the same time. If it is not possible to achieve a separation of duties for organisational or technical reasons, appropriate compensating controls are established in order to prevent or uncover improper activities. The cloud provider has documented any function separation conflicts and the compensating controls established for this purpose comprehensively in a role and rights concept to allow for an assessment of the appropriateness and effectiveness of these controls.

detect_c5_org_04.name: Detect: For Type 2 reporting, the system description must
detect_c5_org_04.description: For Type 2 reporting, the system description must represent all essential changes to the internal control system related to the cloud services which were made during the period covered in a sufficiently detailed manner, including changes resulting from updates to C5.

detect_c5_avail_01.name: Detect: When additional requirements relating to availabil
detect_c5_avail_01.description: When additional requirements relating to availability (classified as A and/or C/A in section 5) are used as audit criteria, this must be reflected in the system description. If all additional requirements relating to availability have been met in full, the system description must include the supplement indicating all availability requirements are addressed.

detect_c5_org_05.name: Detect: The system description must define roles and respo
detect_c5_org_05.description: The system description must define roles and responsibilities of the cloud provider and the cloud customer, including the obligation to cooperate and required corresponding controls at the cloud customer.

detect_c5_aud_01.name: Detect: The audit team must meet specific qualification re
detect_c5_aud_01.description: The audit team must meet specific qualification requirements. At least half of the members must have more than 3 years of professional experience in accounting (auditing), and additionally at least one team member must hold one of the following professional certifications: ISACA CISA, CISM, or CRISC; ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or BSI-certified ISO 27001 Auditor; CSA Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK); or (ISC)² Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP).

detect_c5_rep_01.name: Detect: The audit report must include the following elemen
detect_c5_rep_01.description: The audit report must include the following elements: independent auditor's report (assignment and scope, responsibility of legal representatives, auditor independence and quality assurance including technical qualifications, inherent limits of controls, audit opinion, addressees and use of certificate, notes on assignment conditions); statement of legal representatives; description of internal control system; presentation of requirements and assigned controls, audit activities performed, and individual audit results; and optionally other information provided by the service provider.

detect_c5_rep_02.name: Detect: The audit report must include additional informati
detect_c5_rep_02.description: The audit report must include additional information regarding any existing and/or identified exceptions to requirements. Whether or not such findings impact the audit opinion, customers expect remediating measures for error correction as well as system and process optimisation to be performed. All negative audit findings must be documented with corresponding remediation actions.

detect_c5_sys_01.name: Detect: The controls presented in the system description m
detect_c5_sys_01.description: The controls presented in the system description must be designed appropriately with respect to the fulfillment of the requirements of C5. For Type 2 reporting, the controls must also have been effective during the period of time audited.

detect_c5_rep_03.name: Detect: The audit report must specify measures for future
detect_c5_rep_03.description: The audit report must specify measures for future elimination of the deficiency along with the expected completion and/or effective implementation date.

detect_c5_gov_01.name: Detect: Cloud providers must implement adjustments to C5 u
detect_c5_gov_01.description: Cloud providers must implement adjustments to C5 updates within 12 months after a new version is published. Any deviations must be justified to customers and auditors.

detect_c5_rep_04.name: Detect: All relevant changes to the internal control syste
detect_c5_rep_04.description: All relevant changes to the internal control system related to cloud services made during the audit period must be documented in the system description in sufficient detail.

detect_c5_rep_05.name: Detect: If the audit period ends between six and twelve mo
detect_c5_rep_05.description: If the audit period ends between six and twelve months after publication of an updated C5, the cloud provider must add specifications to the system description regarding measures not yet implemented, indicating when they will be completed.

detect_c5_gov_02.name: Detect: Cloud service security attestations should be rene
detect_c5_gov_02.description: Cloud service security attestations should be renewed at regular intervals, typically every 12 months, to reflect ongoing security posture.

detect_c5_ops_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider ensures the ability to securely
detect_c5_ops_02.description: The cloud provider ensures the ability to securely operate the service on different IT platforms as well as the possibility of secure connections to different IT platforms and termination of the service. This includes standardized interfaces and data portability mechanisms.

detect_c5_ois_05.name: Detect: Appropriate and relevant contacts of the cloud pro
detect_c5_ois_05.description: Appropriate and relevant contacts of the cloud provider with government agencies and interest groups are established to be always informed about current threat scenarios and countermeasures. Relevant contacts include Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), OWASP Foundation, CERT alliances DFN-CERT, TF-CSIRT, and comparable agencies. Procedures are defined and documented to communicate the information received to internal and external employees of the cloud provider and to be able to respond to it appropriately and in a timely manner.

detect_c5_ois_06.name: Detect: Policies and instructions for the general procedur
detect_c5_ois_06.description: Policies and instructions for the general procedure applicable to the identification, analysis, assessment and handling of risks and IT risks in particular are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. Parameters of the top management for the risk appetite and the risk tolerances of the cloud provider are included in the policy for the risk management or a comparable official document.

detect_c5_ois_07.name: Detect: The organization must identify, analyze, assess, a
detect_c5_ois_07.description: The organization must identify, analyze, assess, and handle information security risks through a systematic risk management process.

detect_c5_hr_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider verifies the curriculum vitae,
detect_c5_hr_01.description: The cloud provider verifies the curriculum vitae, academic titles, and degrees of all employees. For sensitive posts in the company, a police clearance certificate is required. The security check can be supported by a specialised service provider. If employees of a service provider have access to user data, the service provider must meet this requirement and make it transparent according to DLL-01 and DLL-02. Special approval procedures in the hiring process for employees and posts for which particularly sensitive information is accessed are established.

detect_c5_hr_01_conf.name: Detect: Special approval procedure in the hiring process f
detect_c5_hr_01_conf.description: Special approval procedure in the hiring process for employees and posts for which particularly sensitive information is accessed are established. This is an additional requirement for confidentiality.

detect_c5_hr_02.name: Detect: Employment agreements include the obligations of t
detect_c5_hr_02.description: Employment agreements include the obligations of the cloud provider's internal and external employees to comply with relevant laws, regulations, and provisions regarding information security (see KOS-10). The security policy as well as the policies and instructions for information security derived from this are added to the employment agreement documents. Corresponding compliance is confirmed by the employee by a written statement before they can access the data of the cloud customers or the (shared) IT infrastructure.

detect_c5_hr_03.name: Detect: A security training and awareness-raising programm
detect_c5_hr_03.description: A security training and awareness-raising programme tailored to specific target groups on the topic of information security is available and mandatory for all internal and external employees of the cloud provider. The programme is updated at regular intervals with respect to the applicable policies and instructions, the assigned roles and responsibilities as well as the known threats and must then be run through again. The programme includes at least regular and documented instruction on the secure configuration and secure operation.

detect_c5_hr_04.name: Detect: A process for performing disciplinary measures is
detect_c5_hr_04.description: A process for performing disciplinary measures is implemented and communicated to the employees in order to make the consequences of violations of the applicable policies and instructions as well as legal provisions and laws transparent.

detect_c5_hr_05.name: Detect: Internal as well as external employees are informe
detect_c5_hr_05.description: Internal as well as external employees are informed that the obligations to comply with relevant laws, regulations and provisions regarding information security remain valid even if the area of responsibility changes or the employment relationship is terminated.

detect_c5_am_01.name: Detect: The assets (e.g., PCs, peripheral devices, telepho
detect_c5_am_01.description: The assets (e.g., PCs, peripheral devices, telephones, network components, servers, installation documentation, process instructions, IT applications, tools) used to render the cloud service are identified and inventoried. By means of appropriate processes and safeguards, it is ensured that this inventory remains complete, correct, up-to-date and consistent. A history of the changes to the entries in the inventory is kept in a comprehensible manner. If no effective automatic procedures are established for this, this is ensured by a manual review of the inventory data of the assets which takes place at least once a month. In the event of a failure of assets which are of essential importance for the availability of the cloud service (e.g., central network components), the cloud provider is able to promptly detect which cloud customers are affected by this in order to ensure a response to the malfunctions occurred that complies with the service level agreement. By means of technical safeguards, it is ensured that the inventory of the assets is updated automatically at regular intervals.

detect_c5_am_02.name: Detect: All inventoried assets are assigned to a person re
detect_c5_am_02.description: All inventoried assets are assigned to a person responsible on the part of the cloud provider. The persons responsible of the cloud provider are responsible over the entire life cycle of the assets, ensuring that information security remain valid even if the area of responsibility changes or the employment relationship is terminated.

detect_c5_am_03.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_am_03.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper handling of assets are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 in the respectively current version.

detect_c5_am_04.name: Detect: All internal and external employees of the cloud p
detect_c5_am_04.description: All internal and external employees of the cloud provider are obliged to return or irrevocably delete all assets which were handed over to them in relation to the cloud service and/or for which they are responsible as soon as the employment relationship has been terminated.

detect_c5_ps_02.name: Detect: Access to premises or buildings housing sensitive
detect_c5_ps_02.description: Access to premises or buildings housing sensitive or critical information, information systems, or network infrastructure is secured and monitored through physical site access controls to prevent unauthorized access. Additional confidentiality requirements specify that physical site access controls must require two-factor authentication.

detect_c5_ps_03.name: Detect: Structural, technical, and organizational safeguar
detect_c5_ps_03.description: Structural, technical, and organizational safeguards are implemented to protect premises or buildings housing sensitive or critical information, information systems, or network infrastructure against fire, water, earthquakes, explosions, civil disturbances, and other natural or human-caused threats. At geo-redundant sites, structural safeguards include setup of a separate fire zone for the computer centre and use of fire-resistant materials according to DIN 4102-1 or EN 13501 with at least 90 minutes fire resistance. Technical safeguards include sensors to monitor temperature and humidity, connection to a fire alarm system with notification of local fire department, and early fire detection and extinguishing systems. Organizational safeguards include regular fire drills and fire safety inspections. Additional availability requirements specify that environmental parameters are monitored and alarm messages are generated when control ranges are exceeded.

detect_c5_ps_04.name: Detect: Precautions against failure of supply services suc
detect_c5_ps_04.description: Precautions against failure of supply services such as power, cooling, or network connections are implemented through suitable safeguards and redundancies in coordination with operational reliability safeguards. Power and telecommunication supply lines transporting data or supplying information systems must be protected against interception and damage. Suitable safeguards typically include redundant power supply and air conditioning systems, appropriately dimensioned uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) and emergency power systems (EPS), and redundant network connections via different physical connections. The cloud provider should determine and communicate external temperatures the air conditioning can withstand and for how long. If river water is used for cooling, water levels and cooling maintenance duration should be specified. Additional availability requirements specify that supply services are monitored and alarm messages are generated when control ranges are exceeded, with communication of self-sufficient supply times achieved by safeguards when supply services fail.

detect_ps_05.name: Detect: The organization implements a scheduled maintenanc
detect_ps_05.description: The organization implements a scheduled maintenance programme for all physical infrastructure and devices to ensure continued reliable and secure operation.

detect_rb_01.name: Detect: The organization implements capacity planning to e
detect_rb_01.description: The organization implements capacity planning to ensure adequate resources are available to meet current and future business requirements, including processing, storage, and network capacity.

detect_rb_02.name: Detect: The organization continuously monitors resource ut
detect_rb_02.description: The organization continuously monitors resource utilization to ensure optimal performance and to identify potential capacity issues before they impact service delivery.

detect_rb_03.name: Detect: The organization ensures that data is stored in ap
detect_rb_03.description: The organization ensures that data is stored in appropriate locations in accordance with legal, regulatory, and business requirements, including data residency obligations.

detect_c5_rb_04.name: Detect: In case of IaaS/PaaS, the cloud customer is able t
detect_c5_rb_04.description: In case of IaaS/PaaS, the cloud customer is able to control and monitor the distribution of the system resources assigned to them for administration/use (e.g. computing capacity or storage capacity) in order to prevent resources from being congested.

detect_c5_rb_05.name: Detect: The logical and physical IT systems which the clou
detect_c5_rb_05.description: The logical and physical IT systems which the cloud provider uses for the development and rendering of the cloud service as well as the network perimeters which are subject to the cloud provider's area of responsibility are equipped with anti-virus protection and repair programs which allow for a signature- and behaviour-based detection and removal of malware. The programs are updated according to the contractual agreements concluded with the manufacturer(s), but at least once a day. The cloud provider draws up regular reports on the performed audits, which are reviewed and analysed by authorised bodies or committees.

detect_c5_rb_06.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_rb_06.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards in order to avoid losing data are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. They provide reliable procedures for the regular backup (backup as well as snapshots, where applicable) and restoration of data. The scope, frequency and duration of the retention comply with the contractual agreements concluded with the cloud customers as well as the cloud provider's business requirements. Access to the data backed up is limited to authorised personnel. Restoration procedures include control mechanisms that ensure that restorations are carried out only after they have been approved by persons authorised to do so according to the contractual agreements with the cloud customers or the internal policies of the cloud provider.

detect_c5_rb_07.name: Detect: The process of backing up data is monitored by mea
detect_c5_rb_07.description: The process of backing up data is monitored by means of technical and organisational safeguards. Malfunctions are examined and eliminated promptly by qualified employees in order to ensure compliance with the contractual duties towards the cloud customers or the cloud provider's business requirements with respect to the scope, frequency and duration of the retention.

detect_c5_rb_08.name: Detect: Backup media and restoration procedures must be te
detect_c5_rb_08.description: Backup media and restoration procedures must be tested with dedicated test media by qualified employees at regular intervals. The tests are designed in such a way that the reliability of the backup media and the restoration time can be audited with sufficient certainty. The tests are carried out by qualified employees and the results documented comprehensibly. Any occurring errors are eliminated in a timely manner.

detect_c5_rb_09.name: Detect: The data to be backed up is transmitted to a remot
detect_c5_rb_09.description: The data to be backed up is transmitted to a remote site (e.g. another data centre of the cloud provider) or transported to a remote site on backup media. If the backup of the data is transmitted to the remote site via a network, this is carried out in an encrypted form that conforms to the state of the art. The distance to the main site should be large enough to ensure that catastrophes there do not lead to a loss of data at the remote site and, at the same time, short enough to be able to fulfill the contractual duties regarding the restoration times. The safeguards taken to ensure the physical and environment-related security at the remote site corresponds to the level at the main site.

detect_c5_rb_10.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_rb_10.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided in order to log events on all assets which are used for the development or operation of the cloud service and to store them in a central place. The logging includes defined events which may impair the security and availability of the cloud service, including logging the activation, stopping and pausing of different logs. In case of unexpected or unusual events, the logs are checked by authorised personnel due to special events in order to allow for a timely examination of malfunctions and security incidents as well as for the initiation of suitable safeguards. Security-relevant events include login and logout processes, creation change or deletion of users and extension of authorisations, use extension and changes of privileged data access authorisations, and use of temporary authorisations.

detect_c5_rb_11.name: Detect: Requirements for data protection, intellectual pro
detect_c5_rb_11.description: Requirements for data protection, intellectual property rights, copyright, and handling of metadata, including description of how they are ensured (e.g., site of data processing and liability, see surrounding parameters for transparency).

detect_rb_12.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that critical asse
detect_rb_12.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that critical assets, including sensitive systems and data repositories, are subject to enhanced logging and monitoring to detect and respond to security incidents.

detect_rb_14.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries c
detect_rb_14.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries can be traced to individual users or processes to establish accountability for actions taken within the cloud environment.

detect_rb_15.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that logging and m
detect_rb_15.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that logging and monitoring configurations are properly defined, documented, and maintained to capture relevant security events and support incident investigation.

detect_c5_rb_16.name: Detect: The availability of the logging and monitoring sof
detect_c5_rb_16.description: The availability of the logging and monitoring software is monitored independently. In case the logging and monitoring software fails, the responsible employees are informed immediately. Additional requirements for confidentiality and availability specify that the logging and monitoring software is designed redundantly in order to also monitor the security and availability of the customer systems in the event of failures.

detect_c5_rb_17.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_rb_17.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 in order to ensure the prompt identification and addressing of vulnerabilities over all levels of the cloud service, for which they are responsible. The safeguards include regular identification and analysis of vulnerabilities and regular follow-up of safeguards in order to address identified safeguards such as installation of security updates according to internal target specifications.

detect_c5_rb_18.name: Detect: The cloud provider has penetration tests performed
detect_c5_rb_18.description: The cloud provider has penetration tests performed by qualified internal personnel or external service providers at least once a year. The penetration tests are carried out according to documented test methods and include the infrastructure components defined to be critical to the secure operation of the cloud service, which were identified as such as part of a risk analysis. Type, scope, time/period of time and results are documented comprehensibly for an independent third party. Determinations from the penetration tests are assessed and, in case of medium or high criticality regarding the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the cloud service, followed up and remedied. The assessment of the criticality and the mitigating safeguards for the individual determinations are documented. Additional requirements specify tests are carried out every six months by independent external auditors.

detect_c5_rb_19.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_rb_19.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the handling of critical vulnerabilities are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The safeguards are coordinated with the activities of the change management and the incident management.

detect_c5_rb_20.name: Detect: The cloud customer is informed by the cloud provid
detect_c5_rb_20.description: The cloud customer is informed by the cloud provider of the status of the incidents affecting them in a regular and an appropriate form that corresponds to the contractual agreements or is involved into corresponding remedial actions. As soon as an incident was remedied from the cloud provider's point of view, the customer is informed of the safeguards taken.

detect_rb_21.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall regularly check for open
detect_rb_21.description: The cloud provider shall regularly check for open vulnerabilities in systems and applications, and ensure timely remediation based on risk assessment and severity levels.

detect_rb_23.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure proper segregation
detect_rb_23.description: The cloud provider shall ensure proper segregation of stored and processed data of different cloud customers in jointly used resources to prevent unauthorized access or data leakage between customers.

detect_idm_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement a formal user r
detect_idm_02.description: The cloud provider shall implement a formal user registration process that verifies the identity of users before granting access to systems and data.

detect_idm_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement a formal provis
detect_idm_03.description: The cloud provider shall implement a formal provisioning process for granting and changing data access authorizations, including approval workflows and role-based access control.

detect_idm_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement enhanced contro
detect_idm_06.description: The cloud provider shall implement enhanced controls for administrator authorizations, including limited number of administrators, separation of duties, and privileged access management.

detect_c5_idm_07.name: Detect: Secret authentication credentials (e.g. passwords,
detect_c5_idm_07.description: Secret authentication credentials (e.g. passwords, certificates, security token) is assigned to internal and external users of the cloud provider or cloud customer, provided that this is subject to organisational or technical procedures of the cloud provider, in a proper organised procedure which ensures the confidentiality of the information. If it is assigned initially, it is valid only temporarily, but not longer than 14 days. Moreover, users are required to maintain confidentiality of their authentication credentials.

detect_c5_idm_08.name: Detect: The confidentiality of the login information of in
detect_c5_idm_08.description: The confidentiality of the login information of internal and external users under the cloud provider's responsibility is protected by the following safeguards: identity check by trusted procedures, use of recognised industry standards for authentication and authorisation (e.g., multi-factor authentication, no use of jointly used authentication information, automatic expiry), and multi-factor authentication for administrators of the cloud provider (e.g., using a smart card or biometric characteristics) is absolutely necessary.

detect_c5_idm_09.name: Detect: The use of emergency users (for activities which c
detect_c5_idm_09.description: The use of emergency users (for activities which cannot be carried out with personalised, administrative users) is documented, to be justified and requires the approval by an authorised person, which takes the principle of the separation of functions into account. The emergency user is only activated as long as it is necessary to perform the corresponding tasks. At least once a month, the activations of the emergency users are reviewed.

detect_c5_idm_10.name: Detect: The system implements automatic controls including
detect_c5_idm_10.description: The system implements automatic controls including: lockout of 15 minutes after 5 failed login attempts with increasing wait times per failed attempt; prevention of multiple concurrent sessions for the same user; automatic lock after 15 minutes of inactivity; minimum password length of 14 characters for privileged users and 8 characters for users without wide-ranging authorizations; password complexity requirements including uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and numbers; mandatory password change after 90 days with next login; and password history of 12.

detect_c5_idm_11.name: Detect: Security parameters on the network, operating syst
detect_c5_idm_11.description: Security parameters on the network, operating system (host and guest), database and application level (where relevant to the cloud service) are configured appropriately to avoid unauthorised access.

detect_c5_idm_12.name: Detect: The use of service programs and management console
detect_c5_idm_12.description: The use of service programs and management consoles (e.g., for the management of the hypervisor or virtual machines), which allow extensive access to the data of cloud customers, is restricted to authorized persons. Granting and changes to corresponding data access authorizations comply with the policy for the management of system and data access authorizations. Access is controlled by means of strong authentication techniques, including multi-factor authentication (see K OS-06).

detect_c5_idm_13.name: Detect: Access to the source code and supplementary inform
detect_c5_idm_13.description: Access to the source code and supplementary information that is relevant to the development of the cloud service (e.g., architecture documentation, test plans) is granted restrictively and monitored in order to prevent unauthorized functions from being introduced and unintended changes from being made.

detect_c5_kry_01.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_kry_01.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for encryption procedures and key management are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The policies must describe: using strong encryption procedures (e.g., AES) and the use of secure network protocols that correspond to the state of the art (e.g., TLS, IPsec, SSH); risk-based regulations for the use of encryption which are compared to schemes for the classification of information and take the communication channel, type, strength and quality of the encryption into account; requirements for the secure generation and storage of cryptographic keys.

detect_c5_kry_02.name: Detect: Procedures and technical safeguards for strong enc
detect_c5_kry_02.description: Procedures and technical safeguards for strong encryption and authentication for the transmission of data of the cloud customers (e.g., electronic messages transported via public networks) are established. When transmitting data with normal protection requirements within the cloud provider's infrastructure, encryption is not mandatory provided that the data is not transmitted via public networks. Strong transport encryption conforming to the state of the art currently includes TLS 1.2 protocol in combination with Perfect Forward Secrecy. Using SSL (including version 3.0) is not considered a secure procedure. For data with higher protection requirements, strong encryption must also be implemented within the cloud provider's infrastructure.

detect_c5_kry_03.name: Detect: Procedures and technical safeguards for the encryp
detect_c5_kry_03.description: Procedures and technical safeguards for the encryption of sensitive data of the cloud customers for storage are established. Exceptions apply to data that cannot be encrypted for the rendering of the cloud service for functional reasons. The private keys used for encryption are known only to the customer according to applicable legal and regulatory obligations and requirements. Exceptions (e.g., use of a master key by the cloud provider) are based on a controlled procedure and must be agreed upon jointly with the cloud customer. If there is a procedure using a master key by the cloud provider, the appropriateness of the procedure must be examined and compliance verified for a random sample of applications.

detect_c5_kry_04.name: Detect: Procedures and technical safeguards for secure key
detect_c5_kry_04.description: Procedures and technical safeguards for secure key management include at least the following aspects: Generation of keys for different cryptographic systems and applications; Issuing and obtaining public-key certificates; Provisioning and activation of the keys for customers and third parties involved; Secure storage of own keys (not those of the cloud customers or other third parties) including the description as to how authorised users are granted access; Changing or updating cryptographic keys including policies defining under which conditions and in which manner the changes and/or updates are to be realised; Handling of compromised keys; Withdrawal and deletion of keys, for example in the case of compromising or staff changes. Legal and regulatory obligations and requirements must be taken into consideration.

detect_kos_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements monitoring of all ne
detect_kos_02.description: The cloud provider implements monitoring of all network connections to detect unauthorized access attempts, anomalies, and potential security incidents. This includes logging and analysis of inbound and outbound connections.

detect_kos_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements controls to manage a
detect_kos_03.description: The cloud provider implements controls to manage and restrict cross-network access, ensuring proper segmentation between different network zones. Access between network segments is controlled and monitored based on business requirements.

detect_kos_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider maintains dedicated administrat
detect_kos_04.description: The cloud provider maintains dedicated administrative networks for system management activities. Administrative access is segregated from general user traffic and protected through additional security controls.

detect_c5_kos_06.name: Detect: The architecture of the network is documented comp
detect_c5_kos_06.description: The architecture of the network is documented comprehensibly and currently (e.g., in the form of diagrams) in order to avoid errors in the management and operation of the network infrastructure.

detect_c5_kos_07.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_kos_07.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards in order to protect the transmission of data against unauthorised interception, manipulation, copying, modification, redirection or destruction (e.g. use of encryption) are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The policy and instructions establish a reference to the classification of information (see AM-05).

detect_c5_kos_08.name: Detect: The non-disclosure or confidentiality agreements t
detect_c5_kos_08.description: The non-disclosure or confidentiality agreements to be concluded with internal employees, external service providers and suppliers of the cloud provider are based on the requirements of the cloud provider in order to protect confidential data and business details. The requirements must be identified, documented and reviewed at regular intervals (at least once a year). If the review shows that the requirements have to be adjusted, new non-disclosure or confidentiality agreements are concluded. The agreements must be signed prior to the start of the contract relationship and/or before access to data of the cloud users is granted.

detect_pi_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider utilizes industry-standard publ
detect_pi_01.description: The cloud provider utilizes industry-standard public APIs and follows established protocols for interoperability. APIs are designed according to common standards to enable integration and data portability.

detect_pi_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider enables customers to export the
detect_pi_02.description: The cloud provider enables customers to export their data in a standard, machine-readable format. Data export capabilities are provided to ensure customers can retrieve their data in a timely manner.

detect_pi_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a pol
detect_pi_03.description: The cloud provider establishes and maintains a policy addressing data portability and system interoperability. This policy defines procedures and technical measures to ensure customers can move data and switch service providers.

detect_pi_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements security controls fo
detect_pi_04.description: The cloud provider implements security controls for data import and export operations, ensuring that data transfers are protected against unauthorized access, modification, or interception during the transfer process.

detect_pi_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements secure data deletion
detect_pi_05.description: The cloud provider implements secure data deletion procedures to ensure that data is permanently and irreversibly removed when requested or when no longer needed. Deletion methods meet recognized security standards for data destruction.

detect_bei_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes policies governing
detect_bei_01.description: The cloud provider establishes policies governing the development and procurement of information systems. These policies define requirements for security, quality assurance, and compliance with regulatory standards.

detect_c5_bei_02.name: Detect: If the development of the cloud service (or parts
detect_c5_bei_02.description: If the development of the cloud service (or parts thereof) is outsourced regarding the design, development, test and/or provision of source code of the cloud service, a high level of security is required. At minimum, the following aspects must be agreed upon contractually between the cloud provider and external service providers: requirements for a secure software development process (especially design, development and testing), provision of evidence demonstrating that adequate testing was carried out by the external service provider, acceptance test of the quality of the services rendered according to the functional and non-functional requirements agreed upon, and the right to subject the development process and controls to testing, also on a random basis.

detect_c5_bei_03.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_bei_03.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper management of changes to information systems for the development or operation of the cloud service.

detect_c5_bei_04.name: Detect: Programming policies must be established for each
detect_c5_bei_04.description: Programming policies must be established for each programming language used, addressing security considerations such as buffer overflow prevention, hiding internal object references towards users, and other language-specific security vulnerabilities.

detect_c5_bei_05.name: Detect: Security controls must be implemented for version
detect_c5_bei_05.description: Security controls must be implemented for version control systems to protect source code integrity, prevent unauthorized modifications, and ensure proper tracking of all changes to the codebase.

detect_c5_bei_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall comply with security stan
detect_c5_bei_06.description: The cloud provider shall comply with security standards established in the industry, such as OWASP for web applications, to ensure application security best practices are followed throughout the development lifecycle.

detect_c5_bei_07.name: Detect: For procurement of products used in the cloud serv
detect_c5_bei_07.description: For procurement of products used in the cloud service, products certified according to the Common Criteria for Information Technology Security Evaluation (CC) at evaluation level EAL 4 are preferred. If uncertified products are procured although certified products are available, this must be documented and justified.

detect_c5_bei_08.name: Detect: Processes are defined in order to be able to roll
detect_c5_bei_08.description: Processes are defined in order to be able to roll back required changes as a result of errors or security concerns and restore affected systems or services into its previous state.

detect_c5_bei_09.name: Detect: Before a change is released to the production envi
detect_c5_bei_09.description: Before a change is released to the production environment, it must be reviewed by an authorised body or a corresponding committee whether the planned tests have been completed successfully and the required approvals are granted.

detect_bei_10.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements procedures for handl
detect_bei_10.description: The cloud provider implements procedures for handling emergency changes that require immediate implementation. Emergency change procedures include expedited approval, documentation, and post-implementation review.

detect_bei_11.name: Detect: The cloud provider maintains documentation of the
detect_bei_11.description: The cloud provider maintains documentation of the complete system landscape, including all hardware, software, and network components. This documentation is kept current and reflects the actual production environment.

detect_bei_12.name: Detect: Change management procedures include role-based au
detect_bei_12.description: Change management procedures include role-based authorisations in order to ensure an appropriate separation of duties regarding the development, release and migration of changes between the environments.

detect_c5_dll_02.name: Detect: Procedures for the regular monitoring and review o
detect_c5_dll_02.description: Procedures for the regular monitoring and review of agreed services and security requirements of third parties (e.g., service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider) who contribute essential parts to the development or operation of the cloud service are established. The safeguards include at least the following aspects: regular review of service reports (e.g., SLA), monitoring of security requirements, and verification of subcontractor compliance.

detect_c5_ops_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider protects information that can b
detect_c5_ops_04.description: The cloud provider protects information that can be accessed by service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider (subcontractors) and monitors the services and security requirements agreed upon. This includes contractual security obligations and ongoing monitoring of subcontractor compliance.

detect_c5_ops_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider assures a consistent and compre
detect_c5_ops_05.description: The cloud provider assures a consistent and comprehensive approach regarding the monitoring, recording, assessment, communication and escalation of security incidents. Incident response procedures must be documented and regularly tested.

detect_c5_ops_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes strategic governanc
detect_c5_ops_06.description: The cloud provider establishes strategic governance of business continuity management (BCM). This includes planning, implementing and testing business continuity concepts as well as incorporating safeguards in order to ensure and maintain continuous operations.

detect_ps_04.name: Detect: The organization implements measures to ensure con
detect_ps_04.description: The organization implements measures to ensure continuity of power supply, including uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), backup generators, and power redundancy to prevent service interruptions.

detect_rb_08.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall conduct regular tests of
detect_rb_08.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular tests of data backup and restoration processes to ensure that backups are functional and data can be recovered within defined timeframes.

detect_rb_09.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that backup data i
detect_rb_09.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that backup data is stored securely and separately from primary data, with appropriate protection against unauthorized access, loss, and environmental hazards.

detect_rb_11.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries c
detect_rb_11.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that log entries contain sufficient meta data, including timestamps, source and destination identifiers, user identifiers, and event types, to enable effective analysis and tracing.

detect_rb_16.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that monitoring so
detect_rb_16.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that monitoring software and systems remain available and functional, with appropriate redundancy and backup mechanisms to prevent monitoring gaps.

detect_rb_18.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall conduct regular penetrati
detect_rb_18.description: The cloud provider shall conduct regular penetration tests by qualified personnel to identify vulnerabilities and assess the effectiveness of security controls.

detect_rb_19.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall integrate vulnerability h
detect_rb_19.description: The cloud provider shall integrate vulnerability handling processes with change management and incident management to ensure coordinated response and remediation.

detect_rb_20.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define processes for invo
detect_rb_20.description: The cloud provider shall define processes for involving cloud customers in vulnerability handling, including notification of relevant vulnerabilities and coordination of remediation activities.

detect_idm_07.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall ensure that authenticatio
detect_idm_07.description: The cloud provider shall ensure that authentication information, such as passwords and tokens, is not disclosed to unauthorized parties and that users are trained on secure handling of credentials.

detect_idm_08.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement secure login me
detect_idm_08.description: The cloud provider shall implement secure login methods that include multi-factor authentication, secure protocols, and protection against brute-force and credential stuffing attacks.

detect_idm_09.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall define and implement proc
detect_idm_09.description: The cloud provider shall define and implement processes for emergency users (break-glass accounts) that include appropriate controls, logging, and post-use review.

detect_idm_10.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall implement system-side acc
detect_idm_10.description: The cloud provider shall implement system-side access controls that enforce authorization rules at the application and database level, not just at the network level.

detect_idm_12.name: Detect: The cloud provider shall restrict and control the
detect_idm_12.description: The cloud provider shall restrict and control the use of administrative software and tools to authorized personnel only, with appropriate logging and monitoring of administrative activities.

detect_idm_13.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements controls to restrict
detect_idm_13.description: The cloud provider implements controls to restrict access to source code repositories, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view, modify, or download source code. Access is granted based on the principle of least privilege and requires appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms.

detect_kos_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider maintains current and comprehen
detect_kos_06.description: The cloud provider maintains current and comprehensive documentation of the network topology, including all network segments, connections, security zones, and infrastructure components.

detect_kos_07.name: Detect: The cloud provider establishes and implements poli
detect_kos_07.description: The cloud provider establishes and implements policies governing the transmission of data, including acceptable methods, required encryption, and data classification requirements for different transmission scenarios.

detect_kos_08.name: Detect: The cloud provider requires confidentiality agreem
detect_kos_08.description: The cloud provider requires confidentiality agreements from personnel and service providers who have access to sensitive information. These agreements define obligations regarding the protection of confidential data.

detect_bei_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements controls when outsou
detect_bei_02.description: The cloud provider implements controls when outsourcing development activities to third parties. This includes security requirements, background checks, and contractual obligations to ensure outsourced development meets security standards.

detect_bei_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider conducts risk assessments for p
detect_bei_04.description: The cloud provider conducts risk assessments for proposed changes to information systems to identify potential security, operational, and compliance impacts before implementation.

detect_bei_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider categorizes changes based on th
detect_bei_05.description: The cloud provider categorizes changes based on their impact, complexity, and risk level. This categorization determines the approval process, testing requirements, and implementation procedures for each change.

detect_bei_06.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements prioritization of ch
detect_bei_06.description: The cloud provider implements prioritization of changes based on business criticality, security impact, and resource requirements. Changes are scheduled and executed according to their assigned priority.
