detect_bei_08.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements rollback procedures
detect_bei_08.description: The cloud provider implements rollback procedures to enable reversion to previous system states if changes cause issues. Rollback plans are documented and tested to ensure rapid recovery capability.

detect_c5_int_001.name: Detect: Requirements shall, wherever possible, be taken fr
detect_c5_int_001.description: Requirements shall, wherever possible, be taken from known security standards and specified if necessary. They shall be supplemented by BSI's own requirements only to the extent needed.

detect_c5_int_002.name: Detect: The origin of requirements shall be documented in
detect_c5_int_002.description: The origin of requirements shall be documented in a transparent manner so that the cloud provider is able to easily perform a comparison with their own security level.

detect_c5_int_003.name: Detect: The basic requirements shall always be met for sec
detect_c5_int_003.description: The basic requirements shall always be met for secure cloud computing. Additional requirements may be included for certain basic requirements where considered appropriate by BSI.

detect_c5_int_004.name: Detect: It is up to the cloud customer to decide for their
detect_c5_int_004.description: It is up to the cloud customer to decide for their specific use case whether basic requirements are sufficient or additional optional requirements have to be met by the cloud provider.

detect_c5_int_005.name: Detect: The cloud customer shall be able to prove that req
detect_c5_int_005.description: The cloud customer shall be able to prove that requirements of C5 are fulfilled by means of a transparent audit performed by an independent, trusted third party.

detect_c5_int_006.name: Detect: The audit shall build on existing standards and ce
detect_c5_int_006.description: The audit shall build on existing standards and certifications and thus generate the lowest possible additional effort for the cloud provider.

detect_c5_int_007.name: Detect: The audit shall be performed according to an inter
detect_c5_int_007.description: The audit shall be performed according to an international auditing standard and shall be suitable for an audit by a certified public auditor.

detect_c5_asset_01.name: Detect: Identifying the organisation's own assets and resp
detect_c5_asset_01.description: Identifying the organisation's own assets and responsible persons as well as ensuring an appropriate level of protection.

detect_c5_net_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider implements measures for protect
detect_c5_net_01.description: The cloud provider implements measures for protecting information in networks and the corresponding information-processing systems. This includes securing data in transit, network segmentation, and protection against unauthorized network access.

detect_c5_ops_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider complies with the security targ
detect_c5_ops_03.description: The cloud provider complies with the security targets in case of new developments and procurement of information systems as well as changes. Security requirements must be integrated into the development lifecycle and procurement processes.

detect_c5_ops_07.name: Detect: The cloud provider checks and verifies that the in
detect_c5_ops_07.description: The cloud provider checks and verifies that the information security safeguards are implemented and carried out in accordance with the organisation-wide policies and instructions. Regular audits and assessments must be conducted.

detect_c5_grc_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider prevents violations against sta
detect_c5_grc_01.description: The cloud provider prevents violations against statutory or contractual duties with respect to information security. This includes compliance with data protection regulations, contractual obligations, and applicable legal requirements.

detect_c5_ops_08.name: Detect: The cloud provider guarantees secure access to IT
detect_c5_ops_08.description: The cloud provider guarantees secure access to IT systems via mobile devices in the cloud provider's responsibility to develop and operate the cloud service. This includes mobile device security policies, encryption, and remote management capabilities.

detect_c5_opr_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider must establish regulations for
detect_c5_opr_01.description: The cloud provider must establish regulations for handling significant incidents and conditions that constitute exceptions to regular operations, such as the failure of critical IT systems. These procedures must define the escalation path, communication requirements, and remediation steps for both the cloud provider and cloud customer.

detect_c5_grc_02.name: Detect: The cloud provider must identify and document all
detect_c5_grc_02.description: The cloud provider must identify and document all functions assigned or outsourced to subcontractors. The system description must include the type and scope of outsourced functions and controls implemented at subcontractors, using either the inclusive method (including subcontractor controls) or the carve-out method (excluding subcontractor controls from scope).

detect_c5_opr_02.name: Detect: For type 2 reporting, the system description must
detect_c5_opr_02.description: For type 2 reporting, the system description must represent all essential changes to the internal control system related to cloud services made during the period covered, in a sufficiently detailed manner. This includes changes resulting from C5 updates. Information relevant to the internal control system environment must not be omitted or distorted.

detect_c5_grc_03.name: Detect: The audit report must specify the measures planned
detect_c5_grc_03.description: The audit report must specify the measures planned for future elimination of deficiencies, including the target completion date when these measures will be effectively implemented. This ensures accountability and follow-through on remediation actions.

detect_c5_grc_04.name: Detect: Specifications regarding the type and limit of the
detect_c5_grc_04.description: Specifications regarding the type and limit of the auditor's liability to the service provider and other report recipients must be included in the audit report. This information is important for report recipients and must be included according to the agreement, while may vary based on country-specific regulations.

detect_c5_up_03.name: Detect: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and
detect_c5_up_03.description: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and transparent specifications in service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation regarding applicable disclosure and investigatory powers of government agencies that allow access to cloud customer data. These specifications must enable an expert third party to assess the general suitability of the cloud service for the customer application. If the cloud provider accesses third-party services, the provider must obtain these specifications from them.

detect_c5_up_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and
detect_c5_up_04.description: The cloud provider must provide comprehensible and transparent specifications in service level agreements, process documentation, or comparable documentation regarding available and valid certifications and certificates of independent third parties. These specifications must enable an expert third party to assess the general suitability of the cloud service for the customer application. Acceptable certifications include ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 22301, proof of compliance with data protection accepted by responsible data protection authorities, audit reports according to ISAE 3402/SSAE 16/SOC 1/IDW PS 951, and software certificates according to IDW PS 880. The target of certification and/or the corresponding scope for system certifications is important.

detect_c5_ois_01.name: Detect: The top management initiates, controls and monitor
detect_c5_ois_01.description: The top management initiates, controls and monitors an information security management system (ISMS) which is based on ISO standards of the 2700x series. The instruments and methods used allow a comprehensible control of the following tasks and activities to permanently maintain and ensure information security: Planning, implementing the plan and/or carrying out the project; Performance review and/or monitoring the achievement of objectives; Eliminating discovered flaws and weaknesses and continuous improvement. The ISMS also includes the IT processes for the development and operation of the cloud service.

detect_c5_ois_02.name: Detect: Strategic targets regarding information security a
detect_c5_ois_02.description: Strategic targets regarding information security and responsibility of the top management must be defined and documented as part of the ISMS framework.

detect_c5_sa_01.name: Detect: The organization must establish, implement, and ma
detect_c5_sa_01.description: The organization must establish, implement, and maintain information security policies and instructions.

detect_c5_sa_02.name: Detect: The organization must develop detailed security in
detect_c5_sa_02.description: The organization must develop detailed security instructions to implement the security policies effectively.

detect_c5_sa_03.name: Detect: Security policies and instructions must be regular
detect_c5_sa_03.description: Security policies and instructions must be regularly reviewed and updated to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.

detect_c5_spn_01.name: Detect: The top management must be notified of significant
detect_c5_spn_01.description: The top management must be notified of significant information security events, risks, and compliance status.

detect_c5_ois_03.name: Detect: Responsibilities shared between the cloud provider
detect_c5_ois_03.description: Responsibilities shared between the cloud provider and cloud customers, duties to cooperate as well as interfaces for the reporting of security incidents and malfunctions are defined and documented.

detect_c5_am_05.name: Detect: The cloud provider uses a uniform classification o
detect_c5_am_05.description: The cloud provider uses a uniform classification of information and assets which are relevant to the development and rendering of the cloud service. The classification should take into consideration: criticality for the rendering of the cloud service, sensitivity to unauthorised disclosure or modification, data type, applicable legislation of the assets, geographical location, context, legal restrictions, contractual restrictions, and value.

detect_c5_am_06.name: Detect: Work instructions and processes for the implemente
detect_c5_am_06.description: Work instructions and processes for the implemented classification scheme of information and assets are in place in order to ensure the labeling of information as well as the corresponding handling of assets. This only refers to assets which store or process information. The labeling of information must be carried out after the classification has been performed and is usually the responsibility of the asset owners.

detect_c5_am_07.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_am_07.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the secure handling of data media of any type are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The targets establish a reference to the classification of information (see AM-05). They include the secure use, the secure transport as well as the irrevocable deletion and destruction of data media. Policies should address secure and irrevocable deletion of data and disposal/destruction of data media, encryption of removable media, and transmission of data to new data media when a medium is replaced.

detect_c5_am_08.name: Detect: Devices, hardware, software or data may only be tr
detect_c5_am_08.description: Devices, hardware, software or data may only be transferred to external premises after it has been approved by authorised committees or bodies of the cloud provider. The transfer takes place securely according to the type of the assets to be transferred.

detect_c5_ps_01.name: Detect: The perimeter of premises or buildings which house
detect_c5_ps_01.description: The perimeter of premises or buildings which house sensitive or critical information, information systems or other network infrastructure are protected in a physically solid manner and by means of appropriate security safeguards that conform to the current state of the art.

detect_ps_04_sub_01.name: Detect: The cloud provider should determine and communicat
detect_ps_04_sub_01.description: The cloud provider should determine and communicate which external temperatures the air conditioning of the computer centre can withstand for how long (e.g., 30°C/14 days, 35°C/6 days, 40°C/4 days). If river water is used for cooling, it should be specified at which water levels the air conditioning can be maintained for how long.

detect_ps_04_sub_02.name: Detect: To demonstrate resilience against interception and
detect_ps_04_sub_02.description: To demonstrate resilience against interception and protection against damage, wiring diagrams and a corresponding protection concept can be submitted, which is checked for plausibility in discussion with the person responsible. During visual inspection, attention should be paid to traces of violent opening attempts at closed distributors, currency of the documentation inside the distributors, conformity of the actual wiring and patches with documentation.

detect_c5_ps_05.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_ps_05.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01 which describe the maintenance (especially remote maintenance), deletion, updating and re-use of assets in information processing in outsourced premises or by external personnel. Policies should address secure deletion of sensitive data prior to external repair or maintenance, analyses of assets prior to re-use to avoid manipulations or malfunctions, and renewal of assets if availability, security, integrity or confidentiality could be at risk.

detect_c5_rb_03.name: Detect: The cloud customer is able to determine the locati
detect_c5_rb_03.description: The cloud customer is able to determine the locations (city/country) of the data processing and storage including data backups. This requirement supplements requirement UP-02 in which the locations are to be documented. If a cloud provider renders their services at several sites, this requirement demands the cloud provider to define precisely at which site the service is rendered and the data processed.

detect_c5_sec_04.name: Detect: Policies and instructions describe the technical s
detect_c5_sec_04.description: Policies and instructions describe the technical safeguards for the secure configuration and monitoring of the management console (both the self-service of the customer and the cloud administration of the service provider) in order to protect them against malware. The update is performed with the highest frequency that is contractually offered by the manufacturer(s).

detect_c5_rb_06_sup.name: Detect: When making data backups, a distinction must be ma
detect_c5_rb_06_sup.description: When making data backups, a distinction must be made between backups and snapshots of virtual machines. Snapshots do not replace backups, but can be part of the backup strategy in order to achieve the recovery point objectives (RPO) provided that they are stored additionally outside the original data location. The business requirements of the cloud provider for the scope, frequency and duration of the data backup are derived from the business impact analysis (see control BCM-03) for development and operating processes of the cloud service.

detect_c5_idm_03.name: Detect: Organisational and/or technical safeguards ensure
detect_c5_idm_03.description: Organisational and/or technical safeguards ensure that granted access authorisations meet the following requirements: Data access authorisations comply with the 'least-privilege principle'; when granting data access authorisations, only access authorisations necessary to perform the corresponding tasks should be granted ('need-to-know principle'); formal approval is given by an authorised person before the data access authorisations are set up (i.e. before the user can access data of the cloud customers or components of the shared IT infrastructure); technically assigned data access authorisations do not exceed the formal approval.

detect_c5_idm_04.name: Detect: Data access authorisations of users under the clou
detect_c5_idm_04.description: Data access authorisations of users under the cloud provider's responsibility (internal and external employees) are withdrawn in the case of changes to the employment relationship (dismissal, transfer, longer period of absence/sabbatical/parental leave) promptly, but 30 days after its coming into force at the latest and/or suspended temporarily. Any access is deactivated completely as soon as the employment relationship has expired.

detect_c5_idm_05.name: Detect: Data access authorisations of users under the clou
detect_c5_idm_05.description: Data access authorisations of users under the cloud provider's responsibility (internal and external employees) are reviewed at least once a year in order to adjust them promptly to changes to the employment relationship (dismissal, transfer, longer period of absence/sabbatical/parental leave). The review is performed by persons authorised to do so from corresponding departments.

detect_c5_idm_06.name: Detect: Granting and change of data access authorisations
detect_c5_idm_06.description: Granting and change of data access authorisations for internal and external users with administrative or extensive authorisations under the responsibility of the cloud provider comply with the policy or the management of system and data access authorisations (see IDM-01) or a separate policy. The authorisations are granted in a personalised manner and as is necessary for performing the corresponding tasks (need-to-know principle). Organisational and/or technical safeguards make sure that granting these authorisations does not result in undesired, critical combinations which violate the principle of the separation of duties (e.g. assigning authorisations for the administration of both the database and the operating system). If this is not possible in certain selected cases, appropriate, compensating controls are established in order to identify any misuse of these authorisations (e.g. logging and monitoring by an SIEM solution).

detect_c5_net_seg_01.name: Detect: The provider implements logical segmentation betwe
detect_c5_net_seg_01.description: The provider implements logical segmentation between cloud customers on the network level to guarantee the confidentiality and integrity of data transmitted. The segregation of stored and processed data must be ensured. If the appropriateness and effectiveness of the logical segmentation cannot be assessed with sufficient certainty (e.g., due to a complex implementation), evidence can also be demonstrated by audit results of expert third parties (e.g., penetration tests for the validation of the concept).

detect_c5_rb_23.name: Detect: For the secure segmentation of jointly used resour
detect_c5_rb_23.description: For the secure segmentation of jointly used resources for web applications which are provided as SaaS, the session ID in the basic level should: be generated randomly and have an adequate entropy of at least 128 Bit (16 characters) in order to withstand educated guessing of the session ID (for example, by means of a brute-force attack); be adequately protected for transmission and client-side storage; have limited validity (timeout) which is as short as possible, measured by the requirements for the use of the web application. Upon successful authentication or change from an insecure communication channel (HTTP), a secure communication channel (HTTPS) should be switched to.

detect_c5_iaas_paas_01.name: Detect: In the case of IaaS/PaaS, the secure separation is
detect_c5_iaas_paas_01.description: In the case of IaaS/PaaS, the secure separation is ensured by physically separated networks or by means of strongly encrypted VLANs. The requirements for higher protection requirements can be used as guidance in the basic level.

detect_c5_pi_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider uses secure network protocols f
detect_c5_pi_04.description: The cloud provider uses secure network protocols for the import and export of information as well as for the management of the service in order to ensure the integrity, confidentiality and availability of the transported data.

detect_c5_pi_05.name: Detect: Both when changing the storage media for maintenan
detect_c5_pi_05.description: Both when changing the storage media for maintenance purposes and upon request of the cloud customer or the termination of the contract relationship, the content data of the cloud customer, including the data backups and the meta data (as soon as they are no longer required for the proper documentation of the accounting and billing), is deleted completely. The methods used for this (e.g. by overwriting data several times, deletion of the key) prevent the data from being restored via forensic methods.

detect_c5_bei_01.name: Detect: Policies and instructions with technical and organ
detect_c5_bei_01.description: Policies and instructions with technical and organisational safeguards for the proper development and/or procurement of information systems for the development or operation of the cloud service, including middleware, databases, operating systems and network components are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The policies and instructions describe at least the following aspects: Security in software development methods.

detect_c5_bei_11.name: Detect: Production environments are separated physically o
detect_c5_bei_11.description: Production environments are separated physically or logically by non-production environments in order to avoid unauthorised access or changes to the production data. Production data is not replicated in test or development environments in order to maintain their confidentiality.

detect_c5_bei_12.name: Detect: Change management procedures include role-based au
detect_c5_bei_12.description: Change management procedures include role-based authorisations in order to ensure an appropriate separation of duties regarding the development, release and migration of changes between the environments.

detect_c5_dll_01.name: Detect: Policies and instructions for ensuring the protect
detect_c5_dll_01.description: Policies and instructions for ensuring the protection of information accessed by other third parties (e.g. service providers and/or suppliers of the cloud provider), who contribute significant parts to the development or operation of the cloud service, are documented, communicated and provided according to SA-01. The corresponding controls are used to mitigate risks which may result from the potential access to information of the cloud customers. The following aspects are at least to be taken into account: Definition and description of minimum security requirements with regard to the information processed, which are based on recognised industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, and legal and regulatory requirements.

detect_c5_sub_01.name: Detect: Disclosure and contractual obligation to the minim
detect_c5_sub_01.description: Disclosure and contractual obligation to the minimum security requirements also to sub-contractors if they do not only contribute insignificant parts to the development or operation of the cloud service (e.g., service provider of the computing centre). Subcontractors are contractually obliged to grant the cloud provider auditing rights regarding the effectiveness of the service-related internal control system as well as with respect to the compliance of the security requirements agreed upon.

detect_c5_sub_02.name: Detect: Subcontractors can demonstrate evidence of complia
detect_c5_sub_02.description: Subcontractors can demonstrate evidence of compliance by submitting corresponding certificates of independent third parties (e.g., in the form of reports according to ISAE 3402/IDW PS 951). This also includes subcontractors of the subcontractor.

detect_c5_sim_02.name: Detect: All customer systems are classified according to t
detect_c5_sim_02.description: All customer systems are classified according to the agreements (SLA) between the cloud provider and cloud customer regarding the criticality for the rendering of services. The assignment of classifications is reviewed regularly as well as after essential changes/events for all customer systems. Deviations are followed up and eliminated in a timely manner. Moreover, the classification shows which parameters regarding the recovery of a system were agreed upon with the cloud customer.

detect_c5_sim_03.name: Detect: Events which could represent a security incident a
detect_c5_sim_03.description: Events which could represent a security incident are classified, prioritised and subjected to a cause analysis by qualified personnel of the cloud provider or in connection with external security service providers. The cloud provider must have at least the roles listed in OIS-03 filled, requirements for the classification, prioritisation and escalation of security incidents defined, and interfaces with the incident management and the business continuity management created.

detect_c5_sim_04.name: Detect: The cloud provider has established a computer emer
detect_c5_sim_04.description: The cloud provider has established a computer emergency response team (CERT) which contributes to the coordinated solution of specific security incidents. Customers affected by security incidents are informed in a timely manner and appropriate form. Instructions are given as to how data of a suspicious system can be collected in the event of a security incident so that it can be used as evidence. Moreover, there are analysis plans for typical security incidents as well as an evaluation method so that the information collected will not lose its evidentiary value during a subsequent legal appraisal.
